systems.name: App shell and URL routing
systems.matches_windows: n/a (Windows is Python/Qt)
systems.notes: UIKit lifecycle. Root is DatabaseViewController in a UINavigationController. .ost/.osp URLs (cold start and openURLContexts) go to ImportService and a failure shows an alert. Info.plist declares both document types.
systems.needs_verification: read only; not launched on a device.

systems.name: Import .ost
systems.matches_windows: No. Bid-less XML is rejected like Windows, but malformed XML the parser tolerates is accepted (IMP-M01) and the write path differs.
systems.notes: Parses with pugixml, creates the schema, refuses a Bids.UID that is already stored, inserts rows with INSERT OR REPLACE and keeps the file's UIDs (IMP-06). import_project commits and returns true whatever the SQL did (IMP-08). BidEmployees and PayClasses are not parsed (IMP-11).
systems.needs_verification: read only; no import was run and no .ost fixture exists in the repo.

systems.name: Import .osp
systems.matches_windows: No.
systems.notes: Own CAB reader (stored and MSZIP via zlib only). Picks the .ost member, extracts only .pdf members into Documents/OST/<bid name>/ by file basename and rewrites ImagePath/OverlayImagePath. No TIFF handling.
systems.needs_verification: read only; no import was run and no .osp fixture exists in the repo.

systems.name: SQLite schema and seed rows
systems.matches_windows: Yes for DDL and seed rows: the 64 Windows tables have identical column names in the same order (script comparison, re-run in the 2026-11-15 doc review); the seed rows match (26 SchemaRegistry versions, the four default layers). Indexes: iOS creates all 129 non-unique indexes and the 2 unique Locking indexes listed in reference_schema_metadata.py EXPLICIT_INDEXES plus 8 more foreign-key indexes that are not in that list (BidConditions.CdnTypeUID, BidEmployees.PayClassUID, BidLaborCostCodes.CostCodeUID, BidPageSettings.BidAreaUID, BidPageSettings.BidPageUID, BidPageSettings.BidTypAreaUID, BidSettings.BidPageSelectedUID, ConditionSets.EmployeeUID; Access may create them from relationships, not checked). iOS adds _AppMeta and _AppPreferences (66 tables).
systems.notes: Not replicated: DEFAULT/REFERENCES metadata (DBP-33), Access boolean values (DBP-34), typed columns (IMP-05, IMP-20).
systems.needs_verification: column sets compared by script in Phase 1; schema creation not run on iOS.

systems.name: Store behaviour (load, write, delete, cascades)
systems.matches_windows: No.
systems.notes: One database file, Documents/ost_projects.sqlite (ImportService.databaseURL). SQL errors are swallowed (for example set_layer_visibility and import_project return true after unchecked statements, DBP-11). Cascades are incomplete (DBP-12, DBP-14). Page-folder tree loses nested folders (DBP-20).
systems.needs_verification: compiled and run on the host with MSVC in Phase 1; not run on iOS.

systems.name: Project browser
systems.matches_windows: No. Hierarchy load matches; folder order (SQLite BINARY, Windows is locale-aware: BRW-M01, decision), bid order, delete, restore and the Deleted Bids identity do not.
systems.notes: Folders (create, rename, delete), bids (move, remove from folder, trash, permanent delete from 'Deleted Bids', 'Restore as Unassigned'), document-picker import, Visualization Settings sheet. Swipe-delete runs at once with no confirmation (BRW-01).
systems.needs_verification: ProjectStore parts host-run in Phase 1; UIKit read only.

systems.name: Project and edit persistence (what is written)
systems.matches_windows: Partly: set_layer_visibility, set_takeoff_negative and shift_condition_ref_nos match (set_takeoff_negative stores 1 where Windows stores the Access boolean -1: DBP-34, decision); the other writers do not.
systems.notes: Writes: takeoff position, insert, delete, negative flag; condition update, duplicate, delete, RefNo shift; layer Show flag; project folders and bid trash/restore/move; render config (_AppPreferences). No page write, layer insert/rename/delete, condition create or annotation write exists (searched).
systems.needs_verification: ProjectStore host-run in Phase 1; UIKit callers read only.

systems.name: Domain model (loaded subset)
systems.matches_windows: Partly: quantity-relevant Condition/Takeoff fields match; several load rules differ.
systems.notes: Loads 9 of the 66 tables: Bids, BidProjects (name), BidPages, BidLayers, CdnTypes, BidConditionFolders, BidConditions, BidTakeoffs, BidPageFolders. All other tables are stored but not modelled (annotations, areas, cover-sheet data, named views, hot links, employees).
systems.needs_verification: read, plus host-run of the loader in Phase 1; not run on iOS.

systems.name: Elevation and position text parsing
systems.matches_windows: No, except the elevation name split/join (parseElevation, reassembleElevation) which matches (reassembleElevation trims only ' ' where Windows strip() trims any whitespace; not recorded in PARITY_MAP).
systems.notes: extract_z_value is a hand-written parser, not the Windows grammar: 145 of 342 test-derived names gave a different z_value/is_top in Phase 1 (ELV-01..06).
systems.needs_verification: host-run in Phase 1; no committed test.

systems.name: Quantities
systems.matches_windows: Partly. Imperial divisors, raw formulas for count/linear/area, straight polylines, grid and negative sums matched Windows in 5000 random cases (polygon area is summed about the origin and loses precision far from it: QTY-14); aggregation, page scope, arcs, slope, metric and rounding do not.
systems.notes: UOM codes 0-9 only (Windows has 11-16 metric). compute_page_quantities skips every takeoff with a parent_uid and passes 0.0 for attachment footprint/perimeter. round_quantity/round_up are modelled and persisted but never applied. Total: QTY-01..QTY-19, QTY-22, QTY-23.
systems.needs_verification: host-run in Phase 1; no committed test.

systems.name: Mesh pipeline (scale, rotation/flip, ordering)
systems.matches_windows: No.
systems.notes: Every coordinate and dimension is multiplied by 1/(sf2/sf1) of its page (Windows meshes in raw OST units, MSH-01). Page rotation and flip are never applied to 3D meshes (MSH-02). Any takeoff with a parent is treated as a hole (MSH-14).
systems.needs_verification: Core host-run in Phase 1; Objective-C orchestration read only.

systems.name: Linear wall meshes (straight, rise/run slope, drop stub)
systems.matches_windows: Yes at generator level. Pipeline-level MSH-01/MSH-02 still change the result in the app.
systems.notes: Drop-stub union with the wall is a boolean step (MSH-19).
systems.needs_verification: host-run in Phase 1; no committed test.

systems.name: Curved linear wall meshes
systems.matches_windows: No (reimplementation, not a port of linear_geom.cpp).
systems.notes: Segment count rounding, arc side above about 180 degrees and the straight-chord rule differ. The curved drop-stub geometry matches.
systems.needs_verification: host-run in Phase 1; no committed test.

systems.name: Area prism meshes (earcut, holes, slope)

systems.notes: Slope direction (GEO-05), tessellation frame (GEO-14) and face winding (GEO-15, needs-decision) differ.
systems.needs_verification: host-run in Phase 1; no committed test.

systems.name: Count and attachment meshes
systems.matches_windows: Square, rectangle (except a negative depth, MSH-13) and circle match; ellipse, triangle, rhombus, hexagon and octagon do not.
systems.notes: Only two generators exist: a box (generate_count_mesh) and a 24-segment cylinder (generate_cylinder_mesh). Shape table below.
systems.needs_verification: host-run in Phase 1; no committed test.

systems.name: Boolean operations (Manifold)
systems.matches_windows: Library code: yes (diff against Windows boolean_ops.cpp shows include lines and a stale TODO comment on line 1 only). Orchestration: no.
systems.notes: 3D view subtracts negatives per condition type; export subtracts all negatives from all positives. A positive removed completely by negatives stays visible (MSH-15).
systems.needs_verification: Manifold was not linked or run in this job (the host harness uses a throwing stub unless -DOST_TEST_BOOLEAN=ON); libmanifold.a not run on iOS.

systems.matches_windows: Replaced technology (Windows: OpenGL/Qt). Mesh-ID picking and the selection highlight read as matching; lighting and shading differ.
systems.notes: bgfx on Metal (RendererType::Metal), CAMetalLayer view, opaque pass plus weighted-blended OIT (accum, revealage, composite), mesh-ID pick pass with readback, selection mask and post pass.

Display Name / Display Dimension flags are editable and persisted but not drawn.

systems.name: OBJ, DXF and Three.js HTML export
systems.matches_windows: Writers' file layout matches (OBJ text, DXF writer: diff vs Windows is include lines, LayeredMesh declared in mesh_data.hpp instead of dxf_writer.hpp, and a write_eof helper that Windows declares but never calls; both write the EOF group inside save). systems.notes: Exports visible meshes of the selected 3D pages into NSTemporaryDirectory and shares them with UIActivityViewController. Failure and 'nothing to export' show the same alert (EXP-21). The HTML imports three@0.152.0 from unpkg.com, so viewing it needs network.

active_blockers.name: PDF annotation export
active_blockers.current_state: No PDF writer on iOS. Search found no PDFKit, UIGraphicsPDFRenderer, CGPDFContext, qpdf or pdf_writer; the only PDF code is CGPDFDocument reading in PlanView/Components/PDFCanvasView.mm. ExportService exposes OBJ, DXF and Three.js only. iOS also has no annotation model (annotation rows are written only by the generic .ost import and deleted only on permanent bid delete and together with the takeoff or condition that links them).
active_blockers.impact: Blocks exporting takeoffs and annotations as PDF markup. Does not block viewing, 3D rendering, OBJ/DXF/Three.js export or import.

active_blockers.name: OST/OSP export (round trip)
active_blockers.current_state: No .ost or .osp writer and no CAB writer (no deflate/compress call anywhere; CabExtractor.cpp only inflates). A writer would also need data iOS does not keep: BidEmployees and PayClasses rows are never parsed (IMP-11) and column types are reduced to INTEGER/TEXT/REAL/BLOB (IMP-05, IMP-20).
active_blockers.impact: iOS can import .ost/.osp but cannot write an edited project back to a desktop-compatible package.
active_blockers.correction: Earlier docs cited presentation/visualization/exporters/ost_exporter.py, which does not exist.

active_blockers.name: No iOS build or device run on record
active_blockers.current_state: Phase 0 added project.yml, build.yml and BUILD.md, all uncommitted. Nothing was built or launched: the authoring machine is Windows (no Xcode, xcodebuild, XcodeGen, ldid, macOS or device). Every statement about Objective-C/UIKit/bgfx behaviour in these docs comes from reading source.
active_blockers.impact: Unknown whether project.yml generates a project that compiles and links, and whether the app runs.

active_blockers.name: No iOS behaviour tests or fixtures
active_blockers.current_state: Config/Tests has a harness with 10 self-tests and 0 iOS behaviour tests; Fixtures/ is empty; the repo has no .ost/.osp sample. 95 of the 216 divergences cannot be host-tested until their logic is moved from .mm files into Core; 13 are objc-only.
active_blockers.impact: No regression protection for any fix; parity can only be re-measured with throw-away harnesses.

active_blockers.name: Data-safety divergences in import, persistence and delete
active_blockers.current_state: 45 of the 216 divergences are data-safety (41 fix, 4 needs-decision). Examples: importing a second project can overwrite rows of the first (IMP-06, INSERT OR REPLACE with original UIDs, host-verified in Phase 1); import commits and reports success after SQL failures (IMP-08); every SQL error is swallowed (DBP-11); cascades leave orphans (DBP-12, DBP-14, COND-DEL-01); swipe-delete has no confirmation (BRW-01).
active_blockers.impact: Silent data loss or partial import is possible on real projects.

partial_gaps.current_state: See B-012. 45 ids; the full list is shown here because it is the highest-risk class.

UomService.hpp defines UOM codes 0-9. Codes 11-16 fall through convert_to_uom (divisor 1.0, raw inches) and get_uom_label (empty string). Bid.measure_base is loaded but only snap_increments_ost reads it. Labels for codes 4 and 7 differ and roofing is missing from the area picker (QTY-16).

compute_page_quantities skips every takeoff with a parent_uid (UomService.hpp:767), so attachments placed on areas count 0, and passes 0.0 as attachment footprint and perimeter (UomService.hpp:790). Any child counts as a hole. 2D, 3D and exports drop attachments that have a parent.
round_quantity and round_up are edited, persisted and loaded, never applied. Not deferrable under the parity rule.
Sidebar totals mix the 2D page and the 3D page set (QTY-11) and are not refreshed on page or mode change (QTY-15). Arc length, slope factor and number formatting differ.
Page-scale division of all geometry (MSH-01), no page rotation/flip (MSH-02), area slope and tessellation.
Segment count, arc side and straight-chord rule differ.
Only a box and a 24-segment cylinder exist. Ellipse draws as a circular cylinder (depth ignored); triangle, rhombus, hexagon and octagon draw as boxes.
Page 1 only, stored page size, no rotation/flip of the PDF; Image layer ignored; overlay fields loaded but never drawn; no bitonal/invert/adjust; no TIFF.
No annotation model, renderer, editor or export. Tables exist in the schema. Display Name / Display Dimension flags are stored but not drawn.
Angle snap 22.5 degrees (Windows 15), unconditional per-axis grid rounding, no endpoint/midpoint/PDF-line snap, no backout mode or paste backout.
No page writes, layer create/rename/delete, condition create, condition-folder CRUD, bid create/duplicate or cover-sheet editing (searched). Writers do not validate existence or ownership.
Update rewrites every column and ColorLine, clears to '' instead of NULL, style change wipes notes and edits, ref number is coerced, elevation text is reformatted on blur.

extract_z_value is not the Windows grammar (ELV-01 to ELV-06); inchesToDisplay rounds half away from zero (FMT-01); position text is written with %.10g (DBP-07) and parsed leniently (DBP-08, POS-M01).

Three.js and DXF axes, mirrored export holes, per-takeoff instead of per-condition groups, no grayscale/opacity, unescaped HTML payload, raw bid name as file name; one alert for failure and empty export.
Basename-only staging collides, corrupt CAB blocks skipped silently, no package validation, only stored/MSZIP, member names not decoded.
Pages ordered by Index1/Name instead of Sequence/Name/UID; folder tap replaces selection; Comments layer listed; initial page differs.
Default mode Solid (Windows Original), one mode for 2D and 3D, negative ColorFill drawn grey, alpha rules differ.
Move, place and delete only; unbounded history; delete cascade covers direct children only.
Fit/Reset framing and pinch clamp differ; camera is refit instead of kept per bid.
Deleted Bids folder is identified by name (UID '1' on Windows); restore ignores OrigBidProjectUID; non-empty folders can be deleted.
Config/Entitlements.plist (Nyxian) carries 25 com.nyxian.pe.* keys; the CI path signs with a minimal get-task-allowed set; minimum iOS 14.8 vs libraries built for 16.0. See B-010.
